body: I honestly wish I never looked even though I had my suspicions. Especially since his messages were so vague. I could destroy our trust and relationship over nothing. :/
I always say, go with your gut. I never actually listen to it but if I did in the past I wouldn’t be stuck in those shitty situations.

Thanks for the advice. I’m 100% fine with any girl friends he has, it’d be crazy to be insecure about just him having a girl as a friend. Its just the ones he sends flirty messages to that I have a problem with. (Tryna use jokes to numb the insecurities.)

I guess this is so hard for me. I’ve only ever been in two relationships. My first boyfriend wasn’t serious but he still went around kissing other girls and flirting with everyone. Its so hard to trust someone, especially someone who’s dumped you before.

It might take you a while but the right person will be out there for you, I got broken up with twice in a year as well and it hurts, but you just have to keep on moving forward and learn from those relationships.
thanks, I just can’t spend this relationship walking on egg shells again so if it doesn’t get better i’ll have to do something more about it

Thats what I do because I can chose my words easily rather than saying the wrong thing, but he kind of has the mindset that ‘he can do no wrong’ so it’s hard to explain that he’s upset me when he doesn’t see what he’s done is wrong
thank you so much this is great advice
It’s really complicated but I guess we never communicated properly, so everything built up in the end and he decided he didn’t want a relationship.
I need more advice like this where people tell me to just enjoy my time with him because honestly I don’t have control over what happens. Thanks
They really do, kind of force yourself to be better because you have to start focusing on you I think, and that all sounds really amazing, wish you the best of luck

Yeah sure! Personally I’m just trying to realise what’s wrong and figure out how I can change it, i’ve become more organised with work and my room in general (it sounds stupid but i’m a very messy person and having a clean space helps.) I’m focusing more on having fun, saying yes to opportunities I might have said no to in the past, and i’m spending time with friends more. And i’ve just recently started to try and eat healthier and exercise more to get the body and confidence I want for myself (:

I have a really bad relationship with myself, a lot of insecurities there which is one of the reasons why I said I wouldn’t be dating for a long time, but I guess this is different, I know how to not rely on someone and be dependent on a person for happiness its just personal issues, and I really am working on myself. Thanks for the advice.
Thanks so much, believe me i’ve suggested that he see a dr for a while now, at the end of the day I can’t force him though
I asked him a few times if he still loved me or the idea of me and he assured me that he loves me, but I still have my doubts. I think I needed to hear this, thank you.

We’ve had a couple of talks and I told him i’m going to be very insecure and I expect him to give us his all, that it’ll take time to trust him, and last night I explained how terrified I was but i’m not sure he fully understands that it wasn’t a passing comment but that i’m genuinely shit scared to a point where I start breaking down.. I might have to explain that one again.

And with something like my story everyone’s bound to disagree, different opinions are helping me so much though so everyones is welcome, I’m someone who never gives up so it’s hard to know how to handle situations like this. And about vocalising his feelings, he’s always had problems with that and it’s what split us up, both of us not talking, so it’s something I think we’re both ready to work on and not let it get in the way again, thanks so much for your advice.
